findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_http_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_grammar · Private data: generate_password, estimate_password_strength, pdf_split, video_compress, audio_merge, audio_compress, audio_remove_silence, converters_file_size · Public sink: extract_emails, audio_normalize · Destructive: format_json, audio_remove_silence, text_paper_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_grammar · Private data: generate_password, estimate_password_strength, pdf_split, video_compress, audio_merge, audio_compress, audio_remove_silence, converters_file_size · Public sink: extract_emails, audio_normalize · Destructive: format_json, audio_remove_silence, text_paper_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
